entry.hypothesis: H3 - the ETFs with the highest trailing 6/12-month return (skipping the latest month) keep outperforming; holding the top N, with any name below T-bills replaced by BIL, beats both benchmarks.
entry.rationale: Cross-sectional momentum across asset classes (Asness-Moskowitz-Pedersen 2013) plus the absolute-momentum switch (Antonacci 2012 dual momentum); a ranking effect distinct from the time-series sign of H1/H2.

pbo.caveat: only 4 trials — at this width the estimate has a standard deviation around 0.2-0.3 even when the true value is 0.5, so read it as a direction, not a number. Values between 0.2 and 0.8 do not distinguish a real edge from noise here.

stopped_names.rule: D07: a holding is sold at the close of its last stored print; no open is fabricated
